argument_review: A.1: Koszul function-linearity cancellations, smooth nondegenerate inverse, metric and torsion identities, uniqueness, coefficient signs and signed speed conservation; no positivity used for existence.

A.2: fundamental-theorem substitution, compact uniform metric bounds, all-path first exit, finite reachability by chart segments, strict metric positivity and both topology inclusions; zero-dimensional and disconnected cases explicit.

A.3: nondegeneracy plus equal dimensions gives a local inverse; pullback connection uniqueness, along-map transport and preserved affine parameter; global distance inequality but no assertion about equal maximal intervals.
A.4: metric difference is a tensor alternating in two adjacent pairs, hence a unique three-form; torsion factor two and same spray, including indefinite metrics.
A.5: all eight coefficient entries, mixed factor two and exponential specialization.

B.1: full open star exponential domain supplies the entire variation strip; torsion formula valid at critical points; energy differentiation and integration prove the identity without invertible endpoint differential.

B.2: radial-angular orthogonality and positive-metric square decomposition; norm only differentiated away from zero; first/last zero limit argument handles arbitrary centre visits and finite radial partitions.

B.3: compact smaller closed normal ball provides a strict exit barrier against all manifold paths; distance-ball equality; zero endpoint, monotone radii, constant angular direction across pieces, pauses and the unique affine parametrization all proved.
B.4: sharp out-and-back length and a positive angular integral excess; partition including the excursion and angular interval proves strictness even when the visiting time lies inside that interval.

B.5: uniform fibrewise metric radius from a fixed endpoint inverse; arbitrary restrictions permitted by the full Geo B.3 construction; exact inverse family yields global minimizing uniqueness and smooth squared distance through the diagonal.

B.6: explicit three-segment puncture-avoiding sequence has length2+2epsilon; any equality path has constant transverse coordinate and crosses the removed point. Local uniqueness concerns affine geodesics with fixed interval.

C.1: compact-time smooth parameter transport includes the centre; radial reparametrization gives A(R)=0, parallel geodesic velocity gives zeta(R)=x, and Cartesian limits give A0=0 and zeta0=I. Gauss removes all polar cross terms; zero/one-dimensional cases included.

C.2: evaluated torsion identity yields the positive beta nu term and W(nu); pulled-back curvature gives the exact endomorphism and sign. Cartesian factors r prove zero initial limits and justify integration from zero, without a singular existence assumption.

D.1-D.2: exponential construction proves all hyperbolic function identities and inverse. All coefficients and four derivatives calculated; every initial position and velocity supplied. Positive heights for all finite times plus uniqueness prove complete maximal intervals.

D.3: vertical integral inequalities and every equality case proved. Inversion differential is a scaled reflection; transformed height cancels scale. The exact circle image is vertical, and explicit centre/radius give a circle for any pair of different horizontal positions.
E.1: earlier full sphere exponential and B.3 prove all nonantipodal distances; triangle inequality and metric topology give the antipodal lower bound. All semicircles give nonuniqueness.

E.2: sine interpolation verified from programme circle addition; positive coefficients sum to at least one. This includes the open hemisphere. Smooth endpoint inverse handles the diagonal. For each larger radius through pi the joining midpoint is the excluded antipode; larger balls contain antipodal nonunique pairs.

F.1-F.2: metric existence uses exact earlier partition proof. Smooth inverse and contractions prove musical maps and commuting derivative. Indefinite Gram-Schmidt and the intersection argument prove signature and local constancy. Explicit derivative right inverse proves the orthogonal Lie group; frame charts, transport equivalence and restricted principal form are verified.

F.3-F.4: normal coefficient identity and compatibility give first metric derivatives. Positive speed and exact integrated square give energy equality and its unique minimizer. The circle inclusion explicitly fails ambient parallel/geodesic preservation despite being isometric.
